title: Totem Assist
description: A customizable low-health overlay that warns you when you're in danger—client-side only, with adjustable color and duration.
body:
# TotemAssist

TotemAssist is a lightweight client-side quality-of-life mod that helps you stay aware of your health during intense situations.

When your health drops to dangerous levels, a smooth vignette appears around the edges of the screen. The lower your health gets, the stronger the effect becomes.

## Features

- ❤️ Dynamic low-health vignette
- 🎨 Customizable overlay color
- ⏱️ Adjustable overlay length
- 🔴 Stronger visual feedback at critical health
- ⚡ Lightweight and performance-friendly
- 🧩 Compatible with Sodium
- 🖥️ Client-side only
- 🛡️ No automation or gameplay changes

## Health Levels

- 10+ HP: No effect
- 6 HP: Light vignette
- 4 HP: Medium intensity
- 2 HP or lower: Stronger effect

## Configuration

TotemAssist includes an in-game config screen where you can customize:

- Overlay color **(best is red)**
- Overlay length **(best is '21')**

Adjust the warning to fit your personal preference, whether you want it subtle or more noticeable.

## Server Safety

TotemAssist does not:
- Automatically swap totems
- Modify inventory
- Send extra packets
- Perform actions on behalf of the player

It only provides visual feedback based on your current health.

## Compatibility

- Minecraft 1.21.4+
- Fabric
- Fabric API
- Sodium compatible

## Requirements

- Minecraft 1.21.4 or newer
- Fabric Loader
- Fabric API

### Optional
- Mod Menu (for easier access to the configuration screen)
